title: Earthy Molten French Prawns Gratin
description: A nostalgic French dish featuring prawns in a yeasty and molten sauce, this earthy molten French prawns gratin is a delicious and satisfying meal. It is a nut-free-friendly dish that is perfect for a dinner party.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and add the garlic, cooking until fragrant.
Add the prawns to the skillet and cook until they are pink and just cooked through.
Remove the prawns from the skillet and set them aside on a plate.
Add the white wine to the skillet and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer, cooking until the liquid has reduced by half.
Stir in the yeast and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange the cooked prawns in a single layer.
Pour the sauce from the skillet over the prawns and top with the shredded gruyere cheese.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the gratin and serve hot.
